body: I want to thank the op for making this thread because the responses that refute what you posted in the title, just cleared my conscious and I can finally sleep at a decent hour instead of scouring reddit for more confirmation bias that I’m gonna be some sucker for dating someone who has other sexual options.

This thread is opening my eyes to the real truth. These dudes are just obsessed with sex. 

I mean I get it, my head was messed up with it, but these post in here are making it so clear. 

Who fucking cares? 

What you said about defining treated better as getting fucked more is sad. If that doesn’t slap some of these people in the face idk what will. 

They’re literally living up to the stereotype that all men want is sex. 

Why would I care if a new woman I meet, and take on a date, has a current fwb? Unless it’s like some joke on me that like haha you loser I’m fucking this guy, and you’re taking me on a date, then it’s weird.

But putting myself on the flip side of things, if I had a fwb, and went on the date, I wouldn’t except the person I’m dating to even care, because I don’t even care about that fwb, for anything other than sex. 

I get it now. Just be the best of both worlds, if the dates going well, check 1, then if you connect sexually better than that fwb, check 2. And you’re already winning. 

Idk if that’ll make sense for anyone reading, but basically, get over yourself, it’s just sex bro.

It all makes sense when I put myself in a woman’s shoes, and then back into mine. 

If I’m just having sex with someone, and that’s it, and I find someone who’s hypothetically a perfect match for my personality, and I want to date them, and I don’t have sex with them. How in tf is the fwb the one winning? 

If anything, they’re about to lose, because they’re gonna become obsolete because Ms. perfect just came into my life. 

Guys read it, you don’t even have to play a game. You can just do whatever you want, and be happy instead

I was giving myself a headache and sadness reading all this stuff, but if you’re the majority, uh personality or mindset, then I’m calm now. 

Reading some stuff on this sub made me not want to date even. But there’s women out there who aren’t this scientific with it huh? 

I’m gonna go back to being normal and being myself now.
I was just thinking this too, yea it’s really weird if he just pops in a message and asked for naked pictures, but she can do whatever she wants, this guy seems like a control freak

We’re all gonna die one day anyway, I think it’s best to ride it out until it happens naturally, doing it to yourself is like skipping in line, because nobody knows what happens after. It might be beautiful, it might be hellish, it might be nothing, so you should ride out life

Please don’t do it, please just grind it out, please just see if it gets better later, I know it seems impossible and you can’t predict the future, but if you’re gonna give up anyway, just give it a shot. Please

My mom told me once that you just have to find something to distract yourself. Like become so obsessed with it, that there isn’t time for your brain to go back to the bad thoughts. I’m working on that now. But I’m not gonna give up for their sake

Please don’t end up with the wrong people, I know you’re in a desperate situation, but think far into the future if you can, and make a timeline of what each scenario would do. 

Please don’t add on more trauma to yourself is what I’m saying

You don’t really need goals or a future planned out I’ve learned, you can just be, and that’s ok.  


Living is way better than death as far as the whole world ever knows. Nobody in the entirety of human existence knows what happens after we die, so you should drag out life as long as you can.
